r.name: Corfe Common History Walk, Corfe Castle
r.description: Explore Corfe Common, a sandstone ridge south of the Castle. Spot signs of the human activity that shaped the archaeological landscape over thousands of years & see wildlife on this level circular. Slopes, kissing gates & boardwalks. Slippery when wet.

r.name: The Purbeck Ridgeway - Corfe Castle to the coast, Corfe Castle
r.description: Visit Corfe Castle & walk towards Old Harry Rocks. Vistas of Poole Harbour, Swanage & the Isle of Wight. Listen for the steam train & picnic amongst tumuli on Nine Barrow Down. Return by bus or rail. Long sections of steps, stiles, gates, slopes & mud.

r.name: Spyway Sea Saunter, Purbeck Coast
r.description: This flat circular on the south Purbeck coast takes you across rich grasslands with great sea views. Optionally detour to the quarry formation 'Dancing Ledge' & a chance to see sculpted animals & deer. Kissing gates & seasonally muddy. Limited parking.

r.name: South Purbeck Cliffs Walk, Purbeck Coast
r.description: Enjoy sea views, former quarries and grassland rich in wildlife on this bracing six-mile circular walk, which takes in Spyway Barn, Dancing Ledge, East Man and Worth Matravers. Uneven and steep terrain with stiles and gates. Take care near cliff edges.
